rule: Bundle as portable_skill when the capability is a repeatable cross-runtime procedure. Embed as core_product when it needs shared state, schema, policy, audit, proof, or eval storage.

entries.name: Agent Context Packet
entries.rationale: Requires shared schema, redaction receipts, and federated memory/provenance state.

entries.name: Run Ledger
entries.rationale: Federates hive/checkpoint/evidence surfaces into one queryable durable model.

entries.name: Shipcheck Proof Gate
entries.rationale: Lane proof enforcement and bypass receipts require product persistence.

entries.name: Goal/Resume/Standup Commands
entries.rationale: Command state machine persists goals, checkpoints, and ledger receipts.

entries.name: GSD Roadmap Operator
entries.rationale: Repeatable procedure for editing GSD planning docs safely across runtimes.

entries.name: MemRoOS Context Consumer
entries.rationale: Teaches agents how to request, read, and obey an Agent Context Packet.

entries.name: Shipcheck Client Wrapper
entries.rationale: Portable client procedure for checking lane proof before finalizing work.

entries.name: Skill Audit Operator
entries.rationale: Interprets skill-audit output and drafts SkillForge proposals for operator review.

entries.name: Bounded Discuss Council
entries.rationale: Repeatable review-council playbook with roles, budget, and validator pass.

entries.name: Hermes Interface Adapter
entries.rationale: Thin adapter over MemRoOS GSD contract; does not own task or proof state.

entries.name: Discord/Telegram Adapter
entries.rationale: Messaging surface adapter; state remains in MemRoOS.

entries.name: Codex/Claude Code Adapter
entries.rationale: IDE/runtime adapter consuming the same GSD API contract.

entries.name: Mark Kashef Transcript Audit
entries.rationale: Research input for v8.3 prioritization; not an executable skill contract.

entries.name: Autonomous Agent Swarm
entries.rationale: Deferred; bounded /discuss council replaces open-ended swarm for now.

entries.name: Graph-First Mobile UI
entries.rationale: Deferred UI surface; control-plane substrate ships first.
